title: Boston Cream Pie
ingredients: 1 cup cake flour (1 cup – 2 tbsp all purpose flour)
directions: 1. Preheat oven to 375°. Grease one 9" round cake pan. Measure above ingredients in a large bowl. Mix ingredients then beat for 2 minutes with mixer on high. Scrape sides of bowl. Bake 25 minutes. Cool cake in pan 10 minutes on wire rack. Remove from pan & cool completely.
2. Prepare custard filling, cover & refrigerate until cool but not set (about 30 minutes).

3. Prepare chocolate icing. With serrated knife cut cake horizontally to form 2 layers. Spread cooled custard on half the cake. Top with second layer, press down gently but firmly. Frost top of cake with chocolate icing. Refrigerate until serving time.
— Creamy Custard Filling —

notes: Written on lined notebook paper; continues on the back (next photo)

Boston Cream Pie
1 cup cake flour (1 cup – 2 tbsp. all purpose flour)
3/4 cup sugar
1/3 cup milk
6 tablespoons softened margarine
1 1/2 teaspoons baking powder
1 1/2 teaspoons vanilla
1/4 teaspoon salt
1/4 teaspoon baking soda
2 eggs
1. Preheat oven to 375°. Grease one 9" round cake pan.
measure above ingredients in a large bowl.
Mix ingredients then beat for 2 minutes with
mixer on high. Scrape sides of bowl.
Bake 25 minutes. Cool cake in pan 10 minutes
on wire rack. Remove from pan & cool completely.
2. Prepare custard filling, cover & refrigerate
until cool but not set (about 30 minutes)
3. Prepare chocolate icing. With serrated knife
cut cake horizontally to form 2 layers.
Spread cooled custard on half the cake.
Top with second layer press down gently but firmly.
Frost top of cake with chocolate icing.
Refrigerate until serving time.

egg yolks until well blended. Cook over medium

title: Meat Sauce / Veal Cutlets
directions: — Meat Sauce —
Brown 1 lb or so of hamb. Add 1 clove garlic, S & P, 1 onion chopped, Italian seasoning – 2 Tbsp or more, 1 sm. tom. paste, 3 cans H2O, fresh or 1 can mushrooms.
Simmer for 1–2 hrs.
— Veal Cutlets —
Dip veal in flour, egg & crumbs, brown well.
Put layer sauce in pan. Put in veal. Cover veal with more sauce. Layer of Mozzarella cheese. More sauce. Sprinkle with Parmesan.
Cover with foil & Bake @ 350° 1 hr.
Serve with noodles & Caesar salad.
notes: From Mary Finch
"Veal Cutlets" circled at right; the veal directions are below a dividing line
serve with noodles & Caesar salad
